description: Copilot-native primitives that ship as working config in the repository itself: the IDE/web bootstrap instructions shim and the cloud-agent validate hook.
standards_gap: Surfaces that never read AGENTS.md (github.com Copilot Chat, Eclipse, Visual Studio, JetBrains chat) need .github/copilot-instructions.md, and cloud-agent enforcement needs the .github/hooks agentStop hook - both Copilot-only surfaces no cross-harness standard reaches.
